description: Person chatting in the desktop app. Short prompts that grow with the conversation, medium answers, almost always streamed, reads the answer before the next turn.
assumptions: A session is one conversation: 1-12 turns, median 3.
New user text per turn ~60 tokens (median); the full history is resent each turn, so input grows.
Answers ~250 tokens median, long tail to ~1500.
Think time is reading + typing: ~20 s median, up to ~2 min.
Gives up on a request after 60 s without the full answer.
